capabilities: Build the LaTeX code block of the open note into a PDF
Build every note named .tex.md in one command
Choose between an installed pdflatex, xelatex or lualatex and a built-in pdfTeX
Write the PDF beside the note or to a path set in the pdf property
Fetch and cache TeX classes, packages and fonts for the built-in engine
extras: Desktop only (Obsidian 1.8.10+ on a computer). The built-in engine needs the network on a document's first build and fetches TeX files from texlive.texlyre.org, keeping them in the plugin folder; it is pdfTeX only and uses a 2020 LaTeX. With an installed program, bibtex and biber are not run, so .bib citations are left out.
problem: LaTeX inside an Obsidian note stays as plain code, so producing a PDF otherwise means copying the document out and running a TeX program by hand.

relations.evidence: With obsidian-cmd-runner, a PDF is built by a script or on a build server
with pdfTeX made into WebAssembly by the SwiftLaTeX project, which runs inside Obsidian

summary: Builds the LaTeX document kept in a note's code block into a PDF beside the note, with an installed TeX program or a built-in pdfTeX.
